notes.title: New Patch: Controller support is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478570/5de978790b72d1c42512f6e7c8ef9f5b33957f68.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Since the game launch I published some lite updates without any announcements. But this patch is different, so I want to make it special.[b] I'm happy to announce the controller support is available now![/b] Detailed list of changes read below.

[h3]Patch note:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Implemented controller support.
[*]Fixed mirror rotation speed.
[*]Fixed player jittering.
[*]Some puzzles have been remade.
[*]Springboard in combination with teleports have been remade.
[*]Disabled manual trajectory for throwing objects.
[*]Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

Thank you for playing!
